sections.title: Origin, home, and languages
body: Ask Varifrån kommer du? Var bor du? Vilka språk talar du?
Say Jag talar lite svenska when that is accurate.
G is often hard before a, o, u, å and soft before e, i, y, ä, ö; loanwords can differ.

sections.title: Present forms and infinitives
body: Dictionary forms often use att: att vara, att komma, att bo, att tala.
Present verbs usually have one form for all persons: jag bor, du bor, vi bor.
Use kommer från for origin and bor i for residence. Language names normally begin lowercase.

assignment.title: Episode 3 mission: Origin, home, and languages
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: Which city does Asha live in?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: Where does Diego live now?

SPEAK: Give your name, origin, home city, and languages. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write a four-line class profile. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Change the city and add a language you study.

RETURN: Answer Var bor du? and Vilka språk talar du?
assignment.model:
Speaking: Jag heter Alex. Jag kommer från Kanada. Jag bor i Helsingfors. Jag talar engelska och lite svenska.
Writing: Jag heter Lina. Jag kommer från Estland. Jag bor i Vasa. Jag talar estniska och engelska.
